evidence: extent.lisp:1043-1044 `(sb-thread:with-mutex (*fnn-extent-lock* :wait-p t) (aref (fnn-extent-entry file eoff elen trailer) ...))`, and on a miss with *fnn-extent-no-io* nil, extent.lisp:796-797 `(when (eq mode :offline) (let ((octets (fnn-extent-read-verified file eoff elen trailer))) ...` -> fnn-extent-read-entry -> fnn-extent-pread, all under that lock. Only owner.lisp:4163 (the chunk span) binds *fnn-extent-no-io*. The POST/IHAVE duplicate test reads stored bytes by handle under the owner mutex (owner.lisp:2102 fnn-owner-buffer-arena-action 'fn-owner-existing-action-buffer). The file's own comment at extent.lisp:883-886 claims 'a stalled disk holds only this thread: cached reads on every other connection proceed'.
fix: Route every served-path miss through the same issued-row and off-lock worker as the span (throw fnn-extent-cold or issue fnn-extent-issue-direct), or bind *fnn-extent-no-io* around the owner's arena actions and handle the cold throw there. Keep synchronous preads under the lock only for offline verbs.
reviewer: The funded pool is never installed. fnn-extent-pool-storage-start and fn-owner-page-read-install-baseline are defined but no host code calls them, so fn-owner-page-read-direct-mode answers :offline (host/page-read-host.lisp:37-43). fn-durable-realize-octet/-octets hold *fnn-extent-lock* around fnn-extent-entry (extent.lisp:1043-1044, 1054ff). On a miss with *fnn-extent-no-io* nil, fnn-extent-entry-direct's :offline arm preads synchronously (extent.lisp:796-797). *fnn-extent-no-io* is bound only in fnn-owner-chunk-span-no-io (owner.lisp:4163). The POST/IHAVE duplicate test runs under the owner mutex (owner.lisp:2102) through fn-owner-existing-action-buffer -> fn-pidx-existing-action-cat. That function compares fn-handle-bytes of the stored payload (books/post-identity-catalog.lisp:69-71), which realizes the extent. A stalled pread therefore holds both the owner mutex and the extent lock. The comment at extent.lisp:883-886 describes only the cold-worker path (fnn-extent-issue-read), so it does not cover this path.
scenario: The pool is in its :offline context, which the stage-0 comment says is how every store opens today. A peer offers IHAVE for an existing Message-ID whose payload extent is not cached. The duplicate test preads on the committer or loop thread while holding the owner mutex and *fnn-extent-lock*. On a slow or stalled device (row A4's scenario), every other thread's warm fn-durable-realize-octet blocks on *fnn-extent-lock*, and every owner quantum blocks on the owner mutex. The whole node stalls, not just the one reader.
title: Offline-mode cache miss preads synchronously while holding the global extent lock (and the owner mutex) on non-span served paths
